[EN] I need to return to Chatran, but I'd never survive the journey. Too many blasted argons!"You will, under my protection."
[ES] Necesito volver a Chatran, pero jamás sobreviviría al viaje. ¡Demasiados malditos argons!"You will, under my protection."

[EN] Excellent! I'm eager to return to work. Let me know when you're ready to set out.
[ES] ¡Excelente! Estoy ansioso por volver a trabajar. Avísame cuando estés listo para partir.

[EN] You're as good as your word, . Thank you."You're welcome."
[ES] Eres una persona de palabra, . Gracias."You're welcome."

[EN] By the way, I found a letter. Judging from all the big words, it's from a baraka. Think you could find the owner? I'd start looking at {@Rgn:78001}.
[ES] Por cierto, encontré una carta. A juzgar por las palabras complejas, es de un baraka. ¿Crees que podrías encontrar al dueño? Empezaría a buscar en {@Rgn:78001}.
